title: Teardown supervised pair (one line of pairs.jsonl)
description: The teardown pipeline is a labeling process: the legacy system labels replay transactions, analysts label verdicts, the UI walk labels screen-to-schema extraction. Every phase therefore emits supervised (input, output) pairs — one JSON object per line of pairs.jsonl — which later serve as fine-tuning data, eval suites, and regression harnesses for the replacement skill.

pair_type.description: replay: historical transaction input to system-of-record output (the legacy system is the labeling function). judgment: evidence bundle to verdict plus why. perception: screen text/DOM excerpt to structured feature entry. design: usage evidence plus workarounds to rebuilt workflow spec.

input.description: the stimulus side: what the model is given

output.description: the labeled response side: what a correct system produces

rationale.description: why this output is correct; one paragraph max

evidence.description: typed citations backing the pair; mirrors the citation shape in feature-inventory.schema.json (duplicated in $defs so this schema stays self-contained)

provenance.description: where the pair came from, enough to trace it back to its teardown

app.description: app slug; may be a category code after sanitization

teardown_id.description: stable id of the teardown run that emitted the pair

phase.description: pipeline phase (0-5) that emitted the pair

created.description: ISO date the pair was written

sanitization_tier.description: raw-local-only: contains tenant data, never leaves the output dir. sanitized-shareable: structure only, names coded, figures rounded. synthetic: statistically regenerated, safe to publish. Rule: only sanitized-shareable and synthetic tiers may leave ~/Dev/teardowns/.

citation.description: one typed evidence citation; same shape as the feature schema's evidence items

plane.description: which evidence stream produced the signal

claim.description: the specific assertion this citation supports, one sentence

source.description: where it was seen: table/report/log/doc, no record contents

observed_at.description: ISO date the signal was observed; null if not recorded

confidence.description: how directly the signal supports the claim
